correctness.rationale: For the exact Definition 3.3, choosing \(\varepsilon=1/2\) and \(M=2\), continuity on the connected complex unit sphere forces the common-time norm image to choose one branch. This gives \(\|A^N\|\le1/2\) or \(m(A^N)\ge2\). Fixed-power division and norm/minimum-modulus multiplicativity make either branch uniformly valid at all sufficiently large times; subadditive and superadditive limits yield exact strict scalar boundaries. Cases \(m(T)=0\), \(r(T)=0\) and equality at either threshold were separately established. No finite experiment was used as proof.
